request: Show one surface for the side panel, in a block that starts with surface("sidebar-1"). Write no text outside the block. Screen: list. Selection: some. Bind $/context/selected_count and show its value. Offer only a button "Pin selection" with the action Event("pin", {count: $/context/selected_count}).

parts.text:
<a2ui>
surface("sidebar-1")
root = Card(col)
col = Column([t, n, b])
t = Text("Selected items")

n = Text($/context/selected_count)
b = Button(Text("Pin selection"), action=Event("pin", {count: $/context/selected_count}))
</a2ui>

<a2ui>
surface("sidebar-2")
root = Card(Text("Select items to see actions"))
</a2ui>
